source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U02 MSMED Act: Identify acceptance, deemed acceptance and the appointed day from objection evidence

facts.statement: Timely written objection within fifteen days moves acceptance to removal of that objection; absent such objection deemed acceptance is actual delivery/rendering. Appointed day follows the fifteen-day period from acceptance/deemed acceptance.

payload.title: Build the payment clock from the delivery record
payload.core_explanation_md:
A delivery date, an objection date and an objection-removal date serve different purposes. Under section 2(b), a written acceptance objection made within fifteen days of delivery or service changes the relevant acceptance day to the day the supplier removes it. Without a written objection within that window, deemed acceptance uses the actual delivery or service date.

The appointed day is the day immediately after the fifteen-day period from acceptance or deemed acceptance. Preserve the correspondence: a buyer cannot simply invent a later internal approval date and use it as a substitute for the statutory facts. Actual disputes about dates and eligibility still require evidence.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an internal approval delay automatically reset deemed acceptance?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory objection conditions and actual dates control.

payload.stem_md: Goods arrive on 3 March. A qualifying written acceptance objection is sent on 10 March and removed by the supplier on 18 March. Assume those facts are proved. Which date supplies acceptance under section 2(b)?

options.text_md: The buyer later chooses 31 March for its accounting close
options.explanation_md: An accounting date does not replace the objection-removal event.

options.text_md: 10 March because every objection date is acceptance
options.explanation_md: A timely written objection moves acceptance to removal, not its issue date.

options.text_md: 3 March irrespective of every timely written objection
options.explanation_md: The definition expressly recognises the stated objection/removal situation.

options.text_md: 18 March, when the timely written objection was removed
options.explanation_md: On the stipulated facts, removal supplies the relevant acceptance day.

payload.correct_explanation_md: On the stipulated facts, removal supplies the relevant acceptance day.

payload.stem_md: A buyer makes no written acceptance objection within fifteen days of actual service. Its internal committee signs off much later. What is the relevant deemed-acceptance basis?

options.text_md: The committee can select any later date
options.explanation_md: Internal processing does not displace the statutory definition.

options.text_md: The actual service date under the stated no-objection facts
options.explanation_md: The definition uses actual delivery or service where no timely written objection exists.

options.text_md: The last day of the financial year in every case
options.explanation_md: Financial-year closure is not the deemed-acceptance test.

options.text_md: The date the supplier obtains a bank loan
options.explanation_md: Financing date does not determine acceptance of the service.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The definition uses actual delivery or service where no timely written objection exists.
